storeOwner.description: Authenticated merchant owner who owns the target store resource

permittedStaff.description: Authenticated staff member assigned to the target store with required permission

unpermittedStaff.description: Authenticated staff member assigned to target store but lacking the required permission

unrelatedMerchant.description: Authenticated merchant owner who owns a different store

resourceBuyer.description: Authenticated buyer who owns the target cart, order, review, or complaint report

differentBuyer.description: Authenticated buyer attempting to view or alter another buyer's private resource

publicUser.description: Anonymous caller presenting no authentication credentials

suspendedActor.description: Authenticated actor whose account or store is in suspended status

platformAdmin.description: Authenticated platform operator with administrative role

revokedSession.description: Caller presenting an expired, blacklisted, or rotated session credential

ambiguousMultiRole.description: Caller presenting mismatched or conflicting credentials across roles
